mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to the prior three months signals an easing monetary cycle, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (relative to prior 3 months), or Rank IC below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% from the prior month signals weakening labor market conditions, which may trigger recessionary fears and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply expansion cycle, a sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO is above 105.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals rising inflation, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month indicates weakening consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals a potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: When HOUST declines, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it signals a potential recession.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or interaction effect not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a weakening economy.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC negative over any 1-year rolling window.
